newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Electoral campaign due to end on Thursday night at 2400 hours.
* Romania's 16 presidential candidates to meet for the first time in a live broadcast by state television and national radio, starting 1900 hours.
* President Ion Iliescu to attend electoral meeting called by the ruling Party of Social Democracy at Sala Polivalenta.
* The opposition Democratic Convention to stage electoral rally in central Bucharest on Thursday.

* A new tranche of FESAL to be made available by end-1996 or early next year if Romania's parliament votes a balanced budget, parliament speaker Oliviu Gherman told journalists after meeting Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm.
* Health ministry signed accord with Italian charity group on project to improve life for 399 HIV-infected children living in the Constanta county. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
